item.title: How two swing states changed American voting
item.description:
Throughline traces how Arizona’s 1960s voter-challenge playbook and Dearborn’s Arab American labor organizing still shape who votes — and who wins — in battleground America.

Episode: https://www.npr.org/2026/09/17/nx-s1-5969824/how-two-swing-states-changed-american-voting

item.title: Is it time for a Luddite Renaissance? (Throughline)
item.description:
The real Luddites weren’t anti-tech scolds — they were workers fighting machines that threatened their livelihoods. Throughline connects that history to today’s AI anxiety.
Watch: https://youtu.be/TTJzsOJ-X60
Episode: https://www.npr.org/2026/09/08/nx-s1-5955618/is-it-time-for-a-luddite-renaissance
